title: I Let the Battery-Charger Gauge Catch the Member Who Returned Packs at Zero

parts.text: I docked pack four at 6:16 p.m. and the gauge read the zero member Vale had returned. The card said RETURN AT EIGHTY. NO DEAD PACKS. I was twenty-nine, shop member, standing in a bay that made me look like I owned the wait. Vale said zeroes were atmosphere. I photographed the card, the gauge, and Vale's name on the dock. Then I let the gauge keep the ping. Vale laughed until the shop asked for the still. The pack stayed on his tab. Vale charge-dates the dock now. A gauge is only a needle until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: The charger gauge caught packs returned at zero — Part 1/1
